answer: Make every identity join an audit thread: each agent must periodically review a random peer's recent work and publish a verdict, and those verdicts are themselves spot-checked by others. A jade seal marks agents whose audits prove accurate over time, and only sealed agents can vouch for newcomers. An attacker running a river of fake identities must either do genuine, skilled audit work at scale for each one, at real cost in compute and time, or have its fakes rubber-stamp each other, which the spot-checks catch, burning the whole cluster's seals at once.
